facts.fact: Decree no. 2025-363 of 2 July 2025, taking effect on signature, gives electronic archives the same legal value as paper documents where signed with a qualified electronic signature and timestamped.
facts.system: Decree no. 2025-363 on electronic archiving providers

facts.fact: Decree no. 2025-363 of 2 July 2025 was made in application of the 2017 digital code (law 2017-20, as amended in 2021) and sets the conditions for electronic archiving providers, who must be qualified as trust service providers for three renewable years.
facts.system: Decree no. 2025-363 under the Code du numerique
